stressors are related to psychopathology in children and adolescents and that the relations are influenced by a number of moderating and mediating variables.

stress matters for children and adolescents, but the field needs to improve how it conceptualizes and measures stressors to advance our understanding of how stressors affect the development of psychopathology.

the field has made great progress in identifying the stressors that contribute to psychopathological outcomes in children and adolescents and in understanding the mechanisms by which stressors influence psychopathology.
